name: Customer Follow-up CRM via WhatsApp and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Customer CRM Follow-up (Indonesia)

### Auto-identifies customers needing follow-up:
- **New Lead**: Not contacted in >1 day → intro message
- **Quote Follow-up**: Quoted >3 days ago, no response
- **Repeat Purchase**: Active customer, no purchase in 30+ days
- **After-Sales**: 7-14 days after delivery → satisfaction check

### Messages in Bahasa Indonesia with:
- Proper sapaan (Bapak/Ibu)
- Professional tone
- Context-aware messaging

### Required Sheets columns:
customer_id, nama, sapaan, whatsapp, email, kota, status (lead/quoted/customer/delivered), tanggal_kontak_terakhir, tanggal_pembelian_terakhir, sales_name

### WhatsApp via Fonnte API (popular in Indonesia)
Alternatives: Wablas, WA Gateway, Twilio
